# Musée d'Orsay

> > The Musée d'Orsay's online research portal, featuring comprehensive databases of French Salon exhibitions and art historical resources from the museum's research center.

This site provides scholarly access to the museum's research collections, with a particular focus on documenting the official French Salons and their role in 19th-century art history. The Centre de ressources et de recherche maintains these digital resources for researchers, students, and art historians worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Musée d'Orsay
- Centre de ressources et de recherche
- Salon officiel
- French Salon exhibitions
- 19th-century French art
- Art historical databases
- Exhibition catalogs
- Academic art research
- Museum archives
- French art history
- Salon database
- Art historiography

## Research Databases & Catalogs

- [Base salons](https://salons.musee-orsay.fr/Focus/Index): Database of French Salon exhibitions from musée d'Orsay research center
